instruction: Re-encode this video to H.264 MP4 and save the result on the desktop as "encoded.mp4".

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: 'Desktop/encoded.mp4', format: 'file_magic', offset: 4, length: 4, default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
